fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (40.5280,-75.6350) were ~5km too far south. Google geocode of 405 Nestle Way, Breinigsville PA 18031 returned 40.5732,-75.6315, which sits on a very large white-roof distribution/warehouse building on the Nestle/BlueTriton/Primo Lehigh Valley campus. Web (nestleusa, wfmz) confirms TWO Primo bottling plants in Breinigsville (~500 employees combined) producing Nestle Pure Life (NPL) and Deer Park brands.
fieldNotes.nplSeparation: The campus has (a) a dense NE production/process complex with dark roofs, tanks/utilities and a red-roof building (~40.5745,-75.6300) = the primary 'main Allentown plant' (idx 4) process halls, and (b) this DISTINCT large stand-alone white-roof building at 405 Nestle Way (~40.5730,-75.6313) with its own dual dock banks, trailer drop yards and rail siding. I audited the distinct 405-Nestle-Way building footprint as the NPL line, and treated the NE process complex as the separate main plant. The two are physically separated by an internal road and grass; I traced only the 405 building's footprint and yards, not the process complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the building's car/dock approach. Street View (pano YhbPa3et_ioh2Dif2TFodw, 2025-05) shows an OPEN driveway with a blue monument sign and employee parking, no gate. The building sits inside an open corporate-park road network; truck control is at the dock, not a perimeter barrier. FALSE (medium confidence - a campus-level gate could exist at the main public-road entrance off Schantz/Nestle Way, outside captured frames).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth-sized structure at the building approach in Street View. FALSE.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on BOTH long faces of the building: a long continuous bank on the WEST face (z19 west-docks crop, ~20-25 angled bays with trailers backed in) and a second bank on the EAST face alongside the rail (z19 east-rail crop, trailers backed in). Honest combined estimate ~50-60 -> banded 50+. Flagged uncertain (banks extend beyond single frames).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on the two opposite long faces (west + east) strongly suggest split ship/receive flows. TRUE, medium confidence (function not confirmable).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop rows at the NW of the building (z18 north-end + npl-full crops show parallel rows of parked trailers without tractors, ~25-40). Banded 25-50. dropYard TRUE.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple parallel rail tracks run N-S directly along the building's EAST face (z19 east-rail crop), with rail cars/trailers staged - a rail siding appears to serve the building. TRUE, medium confidence (could not confirm a spur physically entering a dock door vs a pass-by line, but tracks hug the building).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach roads loop from Nestle Way around the building to both dock faces; deep paved aprons hold 3+ trucks before docks -> drivewayLong TRUE, postGateStaging TRUE (large internal paved holding areas).
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single internal driveway pair serves the building's south/west approach; trucks enter and leave via the same loop. entryExitTogether TRUE.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~20-25 at west docks + ~15-20 at east docks/rail + ~25-40 in NW drop rows + scattered = ~95. Approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop rows + dock positions + apron could hold ~130 trailers.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~32 acres for the 405-Nestle-Way building footprint + its immediate west drop yard and east rail apron, derived from the perimeter polygon. The full campus is far larger; only the NPL building's footprint is traced here.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large stand-alone building (the 405 Nestle Way NPL distribution/production building). The NE process complex is a separate plant, excluded from this audit. -> 1.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in Breinigsville (Upper Macungie Twp), a Lehigh Valley industrial park at the edge of open farmland to the NW; small-town/edge-of-town industrial setting -> Rural per rubric (when torn between small-town-industrial and Urban, choose Rural).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Clear recent Maxar/Airbus tiles plus 2025-05 Street View on Nestle Way; the campus has many adjacent third-party warehouses that required care to separate the Nestle building. Counts banded conservatively.
